messages.content: 甲列火车以 60 公里/小时的速度从 X 城向东出发。30 分钟后,乙列火车从 Y 城(在 X 城以东 300 公里处)以 80 公里/小时的速度向西出发。他们何时何地相遇?

message.content:
<think>We need to parse the problem: Chinese text: "甲列火车以 60 公里/小时的速度从 X 城向东出发。30 分钟后,乙列火车从 Y 城(在 X 城以东 300 公里处)以 80 公里/小时的速度向西出发。他们何时何地相遇?" So we have two trains moving towards each other? Actually "甲列火车以 60 公里/小时的速度从 X 城向东出发" - Train A starts from X city heading eastwards. "乙列火车从 Y 城(在 X 城以东 300 公里处)以 80 公里/小时的速度向西出发." So Y is east of X by 300 km. So Train B starts from Y heading westwards (i.e., back towards X). So they are moving towards each other. Train A leaves X heading east, Train B leaves Y heading west. Train B leaves 30 minutes after Train A. So we need to find when and where they meet.

We can set up coordinate: Let X be at position 0 (km), east positive direction. Then Y is at position 300 km. Train A moves east at speed v_A = 60 km/h. Train B moves west at speed v_B = 80 km/h (i.e., negative direction). Train A starts at t = 0 at x=0. Train B starts at t = 0.5 h (30 min) at x=300 moving westwards (i.e., negative velocity -80 km/h). So for t >= 0.5 h, B is moving.

We need to find t_meet > 0.5 h such that positions equal: x_A(t) = 60 * t (since constant speed east). x_B(t) = 300 - 80 * (t - 0.5) for t >= 0.5 (since after start, time elapsed = t - 0.5). So we set:
